integrity: Finite numerical and rational checks are supporting evidence, not a substitute for the proof. Originality remains provisional pending independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge Boolean cubes and the unnormalized squared graph Laplacian only. The base two-dimensional case is previously covered; high-dimensional single-cutoff and sharp asymptotics are the present contribution. Possible equivalent older radial Fourier-multiplier results remain a priority risk.
title: Sharp positivity times and a logarithmic cutoff for squared-Laplacian heat on Boolean cubes
